content:
Priya (ProdMktg): Quick idea: post-webinar 'Launch Booster' experiment. Offer 50 credits + 4-template prompt kit injected in-app. Objective = +D7 activation and reduce time-to-first-demo. Need short playbook and measurement.

Aisha (Growth): Add A/B for CTA: 'Start with template' vs 'Claim credits'. Also consider 50 vs 100 credits split.

Tom - Content: I'll draft 3 nudges: immediate with recording + CTA, how-to modal, and a 72h tips follow-up. Will include credit expiry copy.

Leif (DevEx): We can inject the kit via internal endpoint and show a one-time modal with 'Run sample now'. I will QA across web and desktop.

Evan (Data): I'll pull baseline D0-D7 activation for last 6 webinars and set up events: webinar_attend, kit_injected, kit_used, tokens_24h. Dashboard by Wed.

Marco (Growth Ops): Routing rule: mark high-engage if tokens>500 OR completions>=5 within 48h. Create CS task and push to Salesforce via webhook.

Priya (ProdMktg): Timeline: copy Tue, dev+QA Wed, launch Thu 09:00 PT aligned with follow-ups. Assignments: Tom copy, Leif delivery, Marco routing, Evan metrics, Aisha experiment design. I'll send Loom with final playbook. :rocket:
